nodes.title: Start frame (the video begins on this picture)
Use an end frame (off = start frame only)
End frame (only used when switched on)
Prompt (what happens + sound, English)
widgets_values: The girl from the drawing waves both arms, then spins around once on the green hill and jumps with joy. Her yellow hair bounces, the white clouds drift slowly across the blue sky. The whole video keeps the look of the picture: a child's crayon drawing with flat colours and thick soft lines. The camera stays still. Sound: a light breeze, her happy giggle when she lands, and a cheerful ukulele tune.

nodes.title: Why these nodes
widgets_values: **Why:** the start frame is stretched to the video size, so the video takes the start frame's own shape (resized to the megapixels, sides on a 32 px grid). The end frame is cropped to that shape. With **Use an end frame** off the switch passes nothing; the End frame loader still needs a picture that exists (`example.png`), because ComfyUI checks every loader. H3 makes 17k+5 frames: 5 s = 124 frames (5.17 s).

nodes.title: Why a fixed sigma list
widgets_values: **Why a fixed list:** Pika trained the Flex LoRA for one exact 6-step schedule (knots 1000/750/500/250/100/40 at video shift 12); a generic 6-step scheduler is not the same. **Turbo** swaps in the community Turbo LoRA (Flex at 0.5 fused with the lightx2v 4-step distill), its shift 6 and a plain 4-step schedule. The switches are lazy: only the chosen LoRA is loaded, but both files must exist.

nodes.title: How to switch the 2x upscale on
widgets_values: **Off by default (purple = bypassed).** To use it: download the two RelayVSR files (Downloads note), select every node in this group and press **Ctrl+B**. It doubles width and height (tested: 800x544 → 1600x1088, +13 s) and keeps the sound. Needs comfy-kitchen 0.2.41 (ComfyUI 0.45.3's requirement); 0.2.40 stops with "no attribute window_attention". Only every 15th frame goes through the model; the decoder restores the rest.

nodes.title: How to use · v1.0.0
widgets_values:
## How to use · v1.0.0

**What it does:** turns a picture into a video with sound using Pika H3 Flex (MiniMax H3 + Pika's Flex LoRA), on the 12 GB files. Optional end frame, optional Turbo (4 steps) and an optional 2x upscale with RelayVSR. Core ComfyUI nodes only.

1. **Your inputs** (green group):
   - **Start frame**: the picture the video begins on. It is set to `example.png` (ships with ComfyUI) and the default prompt is written for it, so the first Run works.
   - **Use an end frame** + **End frame**: off by default. Switch on and load a picture to make the video end on it. Two unrelated pictures give a hard cut instead of a move.
   - **Prompt**: what happens, how the camera moves, and the sound (effects, music, speech in quotes). Long, exact prompts work best. There is no negative prompt.
   - **Seconds** (5): 5 to 15. H3 rounds up to its 17-frame grid (5 s = 124 frames).
   - **Megapixels** (0.4): the video size; the start frame's shape is kept (a 3:2 photo gives 800x544, 16:9 gives 864x480, a square 640x640). Higher = bigger video, more time and VRAM; only 0.4 was tested.
   - **Turbo**: off = the official Pika 6-step schedule; on = the community Turbo LoRA at 4 steps (about 30 s faster here; a slightly different take of the same scene).
   - **Seed**: fixed at 24112026. Type a new number for another take; Run with nothing changed does nothing.
2. **Models**: the loaders must show the files from the Downloads note. Nothing to change.
3. **Frames, size and length**: nothing to change (from group 1).
4. **Prompt + frames**: nothing to change.
5. **Sampling**: the Pika 6-step schedule, or 4 steps with Turbo. Nothing to change.
6. Press **Run**. The **Result** node saves the video with sound to `output/Pika-H3-Flex/`.
7. **2x upscale** (optional): bypassed; see the note in that group.

**What to expect:** a 5 s clip (124 frames, 24 fps) with stereo sound. On the 24 GB test card at 0.4 MP: 94 to 101 s with the 6 Pika steps, 65 to 70 s with Turbo, +13 s for the 2x upscale. The first run also loads the models from disk.

**Tested on:** RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell 24 GB, 64 GB RAM, ComfyUI 0.45.3; also inside a 10 GiB VRAM budget (--reserve-vram, peak 11.3 GiB whole GPU, same time, identical video). Not run on a real 12 GB card.

nodes.title: Downloads + requirements
widgets_values:
## Downloads + requirements

Click the file name to download it. Put each file in the folder shown (inside `ComfyUI/models/`).

| Folder | File (click = download) | Size |
|---|---|---|
| `diffusion_models/` | [minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) | 21.0 GB |
| `text_encoders/` | [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors) | 15.7 GB |
| `vae/` | [minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors) | 2.8 GB |
| `vae/` | [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors) | 0.6 GB |
| `loras/` | [pika_h3_flex_fl2va_v1_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/loras/pika_h3_flex_fl2va_v1_bf16.safetensors) | 2.0 GB |
| `loras/` | [pika_h3_flex_turbo_4step_fl2va_lite_r32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Pika-Labs/Pika-H3-Flex-Turbo-LoRA/resolve/main/pika_h3_flex_turbo_4step_fl2va_lite_r32.safetensors) | 0.31 GB |

Total 42.4 GB. The Turbo LoRA is needed even with Turbo off: ComfyUI checks every loader.

**Optional, for group 7 (2x upscale):**

| Folder | File (click = download) | Size |
|---|---|---|
| `diffusion_models/` | [relayvsr_x2_lightx2v_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/RelayVSR/resolve/main/diffusion_models/relayvsr_x2_lightx2v_int8_convrot.safetensors) | 5.2 GB |
| `vae/` | [relayvsr_flash_vae_x2_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/RelayVSR/resolve/main/vae/relayvsr_flash_vae_x2_fp32.safetensors) | 0.13 GB |

**VRAM / RAM:** In a 10 GiB --reserve-vram budget the whole GPU peaked at 11.3 GiB, at the same speed and with an identical video; a 12 GiB budget went to 13.3 GiB. Not verified on a real 12 GB card. System RAM is the bigger need: the ComfyUI process reached 22 to 25 GiB (12 GiB budget) and 26 to 29 GiB (10 GiB budget), so 32 GB of RAM is tight; 48 to 64 GB is comfortable.

**Run on ComfyUI 0.45.3.** **No custom nodes** (core nodes only).

**Licence:** MiniMax H3 Community License (the Pika Flex and Turbo LoRAs are derivatives under the same licence). It does **not** cover use in the EU, the UK, South Korea or the USA. Above 20 million USD yearly revenue you need written permission from MiniMax, and a commercial product must show "MiniMax H3". RelayVSR: Apache-2.0. Workflow: MIT.
